bead.title: providers: land ADR-010 introspection adapters for OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, rapid-mlx
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. ADR-010 §6' makes introspection adapters a first-class concept; §5' prescribes L1 live -> L2 catalog -> L3 static-fallback. Today internal/provider/{ds4,llamaserver,lucebox}/introspection.go cover 3/7 providers. Missing: OpenRouter (model metadata + upstream params), Ollama, vLLM, rapid-mlx. Until adapters land, the reasoning-wire authority chain only fully works for ds4/llamaserver/lucebox; other providers fall through to catalog-only or static fallback.

Source review: fizeau-8e37e536.
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/provider/openrouter/, internal/provider/ollama/, internal/provider/vllm/, internal/provider/rapidmlx/ each ship an introspection.go that implements the ADR-010 §6' adapter contract.
2) Each adapter has at least one unit test that round-trips a recorded probe response.
3) go test ./internal/provider/... -count=1 green.
